instruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de envelope
prompt: Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a luxurious decorative envelope as the main subject, positioned in the foreground with a strong central presence in the frame. The envelope is crafted from premium deep emerald-green paper with realistic matte texture, subtle fibers, refined folds, precise geometry and delicate pearlescent accents in sage and forest-green tones. An elegant wax seal in metallic antique gold, adorned with a botanical emblem, secures the envelope, complemented by a finely textured satin ribbon in moss green. The envelope rests within an enchanted forest clearing, surrounded by elegant ferns, moss-covered stones, ancient trees and delicate wildflowers. In the softly blurred yet recognizable background, towering trees form a natural cathedral, with winding pathways, subtle glowing mushrooms and distant golden lights creating depth and narrative context. Small butterflies, floating pollen, luminous fireflies, gentle sparkles and drifting leaves are arranged organically around the envelope, enhancing the magical atmosphere without overpowering the main subject. Cinematic lighting with a soft emerald-tinted key light illuminating the envelope, delicate golden rim light outlining its edges, and volumetric sun rays filtering through the forest canopy. Subtle mist, atmospheric haze and floating particles catch the light, creating a dreamy, magical and sophisticated mood. Soft, realistic directional shadows. Intentional harmonious color palette dominated by emerald green, forest green, moss, sage and deep jade, accented with antique gold and subtle warm ivory highlights. Foreground-focused composition, envelope sharply in focus, background softly defocused, strong sense of depth and perspective. Macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on paper texture, wax seal, ribbon and botanical details, cinematic bokeh among distant forest lights. Photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic fantasy realism, elegant, magical, premium invitation aesthetic. 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range, editorial-grade rendering, luxurious and visually enchanting, suitable for premium invitations, celebrations and storytelling visuals. Aspect ratio: 9:16.
folhaInstruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de de uma folha em branco com adornos em torno, sendo essa folha o objeto central e principal da imagem, ocupando quase a tela toda, mas ainda deixando espaço para visualizar o chão, o fundo e os elementos laterais
folhaPrompt: Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a pristine blank sheet of paper as the main subject, positioned vertically in the foreground and occupying almost the entire frame while preserving visible space around it to reveal the forest floor, atmospheric background and elegant lateral elements. The sheet feels premium, handcrafted and refined, with realistic paper texture, subtle fibers, soft matte finish, gently curled edges and precise natural geometry. Keep the entire central surface completely blank, clean and unobstructed, with no text, symbols, illustrations, logos or writing. The sheet is placed within a rich, story-driven enchanted forest environment, resting or slightly elevated above a moss-covered woodland floor. The background forms a magical and elegant forest scene, softly blurred but visually recognizable, with ancient trees, delicate foliage, winding roots, ferns and distant glowing vegetation creating depth and context while keeping the blank sheet as the clear hero. Surrounding adornments are carefully curated and arranged organically around the sheet without covering its writing area, including emerald leaves, moss, small forest flowers, delicate vines, tiny mushrooms, floating fireflies, luminous dust, subtle sparkles and scattered petals along the lateral edges and lower foreground. These elements feel natural and balanced, framing the sheet gracefully while preserving its dominance and the visible ground. Lighting is cinematic and dramatic, with a soft green-tinted key light illuminating the paper, delicate rim light outlining its edges, and volumetric rays filtering through the tree canopy. Subtle mist, atmospheric haze and floating particles catch the light, creating a dreamy, magical and premium mood. Shadows are soft, realistic and directional, with natural contact shadows on the forest floor. Color palette dominated by rich emerald green, moss green, sage, jade and deep forest tones, complemented by restrained golden-green highlights and soft neutral paper tones, with smooth gradients, luminous accents and controlled contrast. Composition: central foreground-focused sheet, nearly full-frame presence, visible margins showing the ground, background and lateral scenery, sheet sharply in focus, background softly defocused, strong sense of depth and perspective. Camera: slightly elevated front-facing view, macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on paper texture and surrounding ornaments, cinematic bokeh from distant fireflies. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic fantasy realism, elegant, magical, sophisticated enchanted forest aesthetic. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Rendering quality: editorial-grade, luxurious, visually enchanting, suitable for elegant magical stationery and storytelling visuals.
cartaoPrompt: Gere um cartão vertical 9:16 elegante, na mesma atmosfera, no tema (Floresta Encantada) e na paleta de cores (Verde). Como identificação do evento, escreva apenas "Aniversário Julia". Escreva também a frase exata "Clique para abrir o convite!". Copie ambas literalmente, sem acrescentar idade, data, horário, endereço ou outros dizeres, e deixe-as visíveis, legíveis e integradas ao design.
aberturaInstruction: Crie um prompt de geração de vídeo para essa imagem com a abertura do envelope e um brilho saindo de dentro, no final o brilho vai fazer a tela ficar toda em branco sólido ao aumentar o brilho.
aberturaPrompt:
A animação começa focando em um envelope fechado com um único selo de cera. Assim que o selo de cera se desprende fisicamente e cai no chão, ele não é substituído, duplicado nem regenerado em momento algum. O envelope permanece permanentemente aberto após esse instante, sem que surja qualquer outro selo.
Uma vez removido o selo, a aba do envelope se levanta lentamente. De seu interior, emergem brilhos cintilantes, poeira brilhante e rastros de luz radiante, espalhando-se pelo ambiente em um espetáculo hipnotizante, com feixes mágicos de partículas luminosas que se curvam em torno do envelope, passando à sua frente e por trás em um movimento contínuo. Essas partículas originam-se apenas de dentro do envelope, aumentando em densidade e luminosidade à medida que se deslocam.
A luz radiante se intensifica e se expande para fora, preenchendo gradualmente toda a cena. Nenhum novo objeto físico é introduzido durante essa transição. O brilho intenso dos feixes e das partículas transforma-se em uma tela branca sólida e deslumbrante no quadro final. A câmera aplica um zoom sutil e lento.
